rawContent: This isn't too surprising. A guy named Abdulwali who was arrested by the #LAPD's anti-terrorism squad! for a fire that the media insisted was related to #Ferguson/#BlackLivesMatter would make a lot of people afraid to champion.

@turndeaux Incredibly, the ATF and FEDS *were* trying their best to link it to #BlackLivesMatter as an act of "terrorism." I think that's why people stayed away from it. It was, after all, the LAPD's "antiterror" squad that picked up Abdulwali in the first place in May, 2015.
